title: Blacksmith Testbox for iOS development
summary: Rizwan Hasan reports using Claude Code on a cloud Mac to build an iOS app, recover from a runner without the required Xcode, and capture 19 screens including Arabic layouts. An iOS team can reuse its CI setup for agent checks, pin the available runtime, inspect screenshot evidence after coordinate fallbacks, and shorten idle timeouts; this early-beta trial lacks Xcode previews and debugger access.
takeaway: Warm an explicit Xcode/runtime pair, install the UI driver during setup, inspect language and screen identity after blind taps, remove unused PR triggers, and stop the cloud Mac promptly.

media.alt: Rizwan Hasan’s source preview for his Blacksmith Testbox iOS verification trial
